<reason>A won a close, high-quality clash by keeping the motion’s honor-versus-archive distinction decisive, especially for holidays and school mastheads that resist B’s “fossilized address” story. B landed real damage on administrability and Washington-as-reductio, but slightly recast the motion as an endpoint-free purge and never fully escaped needing names to be both a live civic model and a non-endorsing relic.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A’s fork that B cannot treat names as continuing civic models for the Washington scare and as non-endorsing fossils for harm and pedagogy; B’s past-tense/present-endorsement reply was clever but weaker on calendars and school titles.</best_rebuttal>
